description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the LanguageService class in the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for methods like getLanguageList, deleteLanguages, getLanguageById, and getLanguageByName, and sets up mock objects for the LanguageDao dependency.

classes.name: LanguageServiceTest
classes.description: PHPUnit test class for testing the LanguageService methods using mock dependencies.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the LanguageService instance and loads test data fixtures.

methods.name: testGetLanguageList
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a list of Language objects from the service.

methods.name: testDeleteLanguages
methods.description: Tests deletion of languages by IDs via the service.

methods.name: testGetLanguageById
methods.description: Tests fetching a single Language object by ID.

methods.name: testGetLanguageByName
methods.description: Tests fetching a Language object by name.
